Giving

We desire to be a community of believers who treat others with the same extravagant grace God lavished on us.

We desire to demonstrate generosity in our individual lives, communities, and around the world in a way that is transparent, real, and helpful.

To enter the amount desired, tap or click on the large zero and start typing.
You should see the amount update immediately.

Ways to Join in Giving

Give Online

Using this page or our mobile app, give securely and conveniently. You have the option to choose a recurring gift or one-time donation.

Give in Person

At each service,  we announce that you can join in giving through the black boxes hanging in the back of the sanctuary. 

Mail a Donation

If it's best for you to mail a donation, simply make the check out to "Crosspoint Church" and mail to our  address: 150 Alum Springs Road, Lynchburg, VA 24502.

If you have any questions, don't hesitate to reach out below.

Have questions or need help?

We'd love to hear from you. Fill out the form below to get started.
